text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Tch. And here I thought it was 
unusually quiet today. Who's the one 
calling out to me?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Ain't nobody here. Guess that static 
is still ringing in my head."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The statue of the Three Goddesses, huh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It'd be real fun if I could gather some 
data on just how crazy strong she is.
